title: How a Subsistence Crisis Happens
details: steps: Bad harvest -> Scarcity of grain -> Rising food prices -> The poorest can no longer buy bread -> Weaker bodies and disease epidemics -> More deaths and food riots
use_why: it is a process to draw step by step

title: An anonymous 17th-century French etching shows a seated, richly dressed nobleman with a dog, receiving a money bag, a ba
details: illustration: An anonymous 17th-century French etching shows a seated, richly dressed nobleman with a dog, receiving a money bag, a basket of fruit and a sack of grain from a thin, bearded peasant. A spider web with a spider and trapped fly appears at top left, and a fly is drawn near the verses. Students should notice how the verses and the web image frame the noble as a predator who feeds on the labour of the poor peasant.
